title: Common Definitions
description: Shared definitions for QA contract schemas. Referenced by the other schemas as _common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>. Canonical source: docs/AGENT-CONTRACTS.md.

failureCategory.description: Failure Classification categories. FAIL is not APP_BUG automatically.

resultStatus.description: Execution result status for a Test Result.

evidenceItem.description: An evidence reference. Either a plain string (path or traceable reference) or a structured object. The string form is kept for compatibility with existing artifacts in qa/.

capabilityState.description: Pre-flight capability state (M-04). Mirrors the vocabulary in docs/PRE-FLIGHT-CAPABILITIES.md; validation never transforms it. AVAILABLE/NOT_REQUIRED never block; REQUIRES_CONFIGURATION/NOT_INSTALLED/UNVERIFIED on a required check make the pre-flight BLOCKED. PROBE_DENIED/PROBE_INCONCLUSIVE are non-blocking WARNs that only appear when need.target.browser_fallback is declared: the HTTP probe could not confirm access, so accessibility is decided by the browser navigation evidence, never by the probe.

traceability.description: Test Case traceability (requirement / risk / Test Data).
